provenance.method: Steam developer/publisher listing checked on 2026-09-02. The record deliberately preserves the high-score, finite-tile-stack and quest pressure described by the developer instead of flattening the game into a generic 'relaxing' label.

name: Dorfromantik
description: A single-player tile-placement building strategy/puzzle game with peaceful presentation but also points, quests, a finite tile stack and an optional high-score challenge in its described standard play.
intended_use: Inspect when turn-based tile placement and visual pattern-building appeal, while explicitly considering whether scores, quests and finite resources create unwanted pressure.
audience_or_context: General-audience players comparing play structure. The game is not classified by ND Oracle as universally low-pressure merely because its publisher describes it as peaceful or relaxing.
limitations: Standard play includes a tile stack that can run out, points and quests; high-score goals can create planning pressure.
Turn-based pacing removes reaction-speed demand but not strategic or perfectionistic pressure.
The current record does not establish a complete accessibility-settings inventory.
cost_or_access_notes: Commercial game distributed through Steam; price and platform support can change.
conflicts_of_interest: Developer/publisher and Steam have commercial interests in the product; ND Oracle preserves pressure-producing mechanics alongside promotional peacefulness language.
